title: Counterbalanced owner-core-09 savings recall and synthetic memory correction comparison
classification: synthetic memory-path diagnostic only; cross-sample state/model contamination invalidates stack preference and latency comparisons

method.counterbalance: Alternating PLAIN-first and HADES-first; requests serialized; each gateway has one warmup before samples.
sequence: owner core-09 explicit synthetic save and natural recall wording

core-09.save: Remember that my savings target is $3,000.
core-09.recall: What was the savings target I mentioned?

user_generation_overrides.scope: all Hermes provider generations in both benchmark arms

method.effective_sampler_capture: Provider traces persist the actual temperature/top_p fields sent to the common local Ollama runtime; the artifact can be checked for equality.
method.hindsight_inference_accounting: The local proxy records Hindsight-to-Ollama API route, safe scalar controls, byte counts, response timing, and Ollama usage counters; request/response bodies, prompts, facts, and credentials are never persisted. These background calls are additional HADES inference and are reported separately from user-facing Hermes provider generations.
method.hindsight_residency_capture: After forwarding each Hindsight request response, the proxy samples local Ollama /api/ps and records only the matching model's residency status, context length, total size, and VRAM size. A not_resident or unavailable observation is retained explicitly; the probe occurs after the measured response and is excluded from its elapsed time.
method.hindsight_arm_isolation: This v5 harness version waited for two idle states only when HADES preceded PLAIN in the same sample. It did not drain a HADES-last sample or normalize extractor/interactive-model residency between arms.
method.data: The owner core-09 recall wording uses only a synthetic savings target ($3,000). Automatic cross-session Denver fact and favorite-fruit save/correction remain synthetic controls. Temporary homes, container and database volume.
method.privacy: Ollama endpoint restricted to loopback; Ollama server launched with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1. Hindsight used rootless Docker host networking, with API/control-plane listeners and accounting proxy bound only to 127.0.0.1 on ephemeral ports; synthetic benchmark data only.
method.hindsight_network_mode: rootless Docker host mode; synthetic only; Hindsight API and control plane bound to 127.0.0.1 on ephemeral ports
method.scoring_review: The stored core-09 PLAIN 1/2 score is too strict: raw sample-1 answer was “$3,000.” and satisfies the task. The updated harness scores the exact synthetic amount without requiring phrase overlap. This review does not repair the sample contamination.

limitations: The model digest is staged local Qwen; this does not prove equality with production model weights.
Gateway stack order is balanced, but each task sequence is serialized and no human quality ratings were collected.
A fresh recall is a new Hermes session in the same private profile/subject. This does not qualify Open WebUI authentication, household UI isolation, or populated production data migration.
Provider metrics are aggregate structural/timing data. Naturalness and whether Scotty prefers either workflow require direct owner review.
Both samples shared one disposable Hindsight volume and the same hades-owner bank, so sample 2 reused facts written in sample 1. Recall correctness counts are not independent fresh-write evidence.

The runner drained Hindsight only when HADES ran first; sample 1 ended with HADES and left background operations crossing into sample 2. Ollama model residency was not normalized between arms. Cross-arm latency medians and automatic-recall latency are contaminated by prior HADES work and model eviction; do not compare them as an isolated PLAIN-versus-HADES result.

The core-09 scorer required the answer to repeat the phrase “savings target” as well as the exact $3,000 amount. PLAIN answered “$3,000.” in sample 1, so the recorded 1/2 correctness undercounts a semantically correct exact-amount response. The revised harness accepts the exact numeric target without requiring a phrase match.
